main_measure.name: slope of excess next-day return on forecast, regime bars

statistic.name: t, standard errors clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and check passes); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess next-day return on regime bars with forecast >= 2, above 0

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the mean excess next-day return on forecast >= 2 bars is above 0.
reading: Situation computed from prices as (close-low)/(high-low) < 0.5 (zero-range bars count as outside it), long side; the slope is a pooled OLS with intercept of excess next-day return on forecast over regime bars of all coins and windows, with day-clustered (CR1) standard errors; the coin's mean daily return is the mean of all its next-bar returns over all windows; the t of the forecast>=2 excess return in the reject rule is the ordinary t of the mean; counts are regime bars with a next-day return.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.001089 on the check folds against +0.00118 on every fold
